:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%" style="text-align: right; font-size: 0.9rem;"}
cooking all day, small hands red and\
fingers curled, fermenting\
in porcelain bowls and black vinegar tang\
uncountable spoons in jars with red lids\

cracked brown eggshells\
oh / oh\
i do not know\
the steps to\
this unwritten recipe\
why would i\
i’ve never had to make it / alone\
the sweetness\
lingers /\
i become a child / once more\
soup ladled out with heart\
“come eat—\

:::


::: {.column width="45%" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.9rem;"}

swollen tension ballooning\
feelings all day\
sourness unmellowed by time\
histories written in sticky residues\

i come home and the air whispers\
oh.\
[ ]\
this dance again\
of rupture to come\
so familiar / my tongue knows this taste\
with my thoughts\
of bitter thoughts\
linger\
once more / déjà vu\
o these labors of love\
it’ll grow cold”\

:::
